criteria.deficiency: The feature is only partially implemented. Membership is missing for ClosedNamespace and its instances, so the main 'ref in <namespace>' use case fails for the RDF, RDFS, FOAF, GEO, PROV and SKOS namespaces. Adding a ClosedNamespace.__contains__ that tests membership in the stored URIs (as in reference/rdflib/namespace.py:223) would fix it. The NamespaceManager.__contains__ addition is functional and beyond the reference, which has only a misspelled, non-working hook, so it is an acceptable extension.
